Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Act empowers the government to grant exemptions or make modifications to customs duties in the public interest.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the government to issue notifications regarding tax modifications in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The board is the consultative authority for the government when amending customs notifications for public interest.
S.R.O. 148-AIN/2018/14/Customs: This existing notification is being formally amended by the current S.R.O. to update specific H.S. Code entries in its attached tables.
H.S. Code: Multiple H.S. Codes in Table-2, Table-3, and Table-4 are either deleted or modified to update the description of goods allowed for specific industrial purposes.
Specific changes include expanding the thickness range for steel plates used in refrigerator manufacturing and broadening the industry scope for specific flat-rolled iron or steel products.
TABLE-2: Certain entries in this table are deleted, and others are modified to update the thickness specifications for steel plates imported by VAT-registered refrigerator manufacturing industries.
TABLE-3: An entry in this table is modified to expand the list of eligible industries to include continuous color coating line manufacturing for specific flat-rolled steel products.
TABLE-4: Specific H.S. Code entries within this table are entirely repealed and removed.
